scope: Completed source advisory on clean established book startup; not production acceptance, not blanket acceptance of every worker statement.
accepted_findings: With no pending target or WAL, clean preflight acquires per-book lock and does not synthesize settlement or model calls.
Preflight is not universally read-only: it creates lock paths and can replay existing WAL/account/fills/receipt state.
WAL failure and receipt/queue hash invariants require explicit non-clean-state handling; source code rollback does not undo these effects.

corrections.claim: run_events is in-memory/volatile and not durable
corrections.ruling: Incorrect. control_plane/run_events.py writes append-only data/governance/run_events.jsonl; the real isolated startup also recorded a write to this path.

corrections.claim: Use arbitrary scratch book ID zz_boundary_probe
corrections.ruling: Invalid under the registry allowlist. Isolated proofs must use allowlisted book IDs under a separate data root, as root's actual rehearsal did.

corrections.claim: A second instance or NFS broadly defeats flock
corrections.ruling: Not established here. The observed data filesystem is ext4; cooperative processes use the same canonical lock. Preserve actual contention and noncooperating-writer limitations without claiming observed lock failure.

corrections.claim: Any quarantined non-OK result universally hard-stops startup
corrections.ruling: Too broad. Actual callers distinguish a successfully quarantined rejected queue from a blocking failure. Current rehearsal used no pending target/WAL, so this branch was not accepted by execution.

corrections.claim: No schema migration anywhere in the release
corrections.ruling: Review scope cannot establish that broad claim. Preserve release-integrity receipt-v2/WAL/outbox refusal boundaries and version-qualified restore behavior.

unexecuted_suggestions: The worker's eight suggested cases were not executed; they are not needed to claim the observed clean-state startup. No provider calls, fits or production mutations were commissioned by this review.
